smells.reason: init/resume legitimately returns agents_dir pointing at the install tree's agents/ directory, which sits outside the QA walk's temp project root by design (agents are installed once, not per-project) — see #2966 and oracles.cjs's value-hygiene header comment on why this is a strict-equality-only sentinel check, never a substring scan.

state-snapshot uses the documented soft-failure idiom (output({error:...}) while exiting 0) when STATE.md does not exist yet on a greenfield project. 42 call sites across the engine use this idiom; oracles.cjs rates changing it CRITICAL blast radius — tracked as a known trade-off, not a regression, see #2966.
Same init agents_dir-outside-project-root behavior as every other scenario's init call — see #2966.

total_plans legitimately resets to 0 when `stats` is read after a real milestone rollover (v1.0 -> v2.0) — a new milestone's ROADMAP.md has not accumulated any plans yet. This is the exact scope-boundary case monotonic-progress's SEVERITY.SMELL split exists to distinguish from a real regression — see #2966.

`roadmap get-phase 1` reports ROADMAP.md not found via the same output({error:...})-exit-0 soft-failure idiom after the perturbation deletes the artifact — same known trade-off as the state-snapshot occurrences above, see #2966.
